_readme: EVERY WORD THE VIDEO DRAWS LIVES HERE. Edit this file, save it, run the tool.
There is nothing to rebuild and no Python to touch.
SYMBOLS: the card draws from one font with no emoji fallback.
These do NOT:    ▶  ♡  ⬇  🎟  ★   (they render as empty boxes)
Always render one card and look at it before trusting a new symbol.
{who} in a line is replaced by whoever mixed the episode (--mixed-by).
If that is unknown, the matching *_anon line is used instead.
Leave a line as "" to hide it. An empty outro 'tease' drops its reveal beat
rather than holding on an unchanged slide.
If this file is missing or unreadable the tool falls back to built-in copy,
so a typo here can never stop a render -- it just warns and carries on.

_note: Static tags go out on EVERY episode, in this order, before the genres.
YouTube allows 500 characters of tags in total; SoundCloud takes 30 tags.
make_tags.py fills the rest with the genres actually played, most common
first, and tells you if anything had to be cut.
